label: Night Road
description: Drivable night stages — roads, ramps and lots a performance machine can actually own after dark. Every item bakes in night and declares it.

items.name: wet-arterial
items.text: A rain-flooded six-lane arterial at three in the morning, signal heads stretching red and green ribbons down the lane grooves, spray still hanging where the last car passed.
items.text_short: wet night arterial, stretched signal reflections

items.name: touge-descent
items.text: A mountain touge descending in stacked hairpins, cat-eye reflectors tracing the camber through cedar darkness, valley fog pooling two corners below.
items.text_short: night touge hairpins, cat-eye reflectors, valley fog

items.name: container-canyon
items.text: A dockside lane walled in by stacked shipping containers, one gantry floodlight slicing the corridor into hard bands of glare and shadow, crane silhouettes overhead.

items.name: onramp-spiral
items.text: An elevated expressway onramp coiling upward through sodium light, banked concrete and painted chevrons wound into one glowing spiral.

items.name: toll-plaza
items.text: A deserted toll plaza after midnight, barriers raised, lane lights counting down the empty booths under a long steel canopy.
items.text_short: empty midnight toll plaza, raised barriers

items.name: desert-interstate
items.text: A dead-straight desert interstate under a bowl of stars, the centerline running out to a faint town glow on the horizon, heat still lifting off the blacktop.
items.text_short: desert interstate under stars, distant town glow

items.name: canyon-guardrail
items.text: A canyon road pinched between rock wall and battered guardrail, moonlight chalking the cliff faces above the dark ribbon of tarmac.

items.name: concrete-underpass
items.text: A multi-column concrete underpass, sodium pools spaced between the pillars, chain-link fencing and painted clearance markings catching the light.

items.name: city-overlook
items.text: A gravel overlook above the city, a low stone wall at the drop, the whole basin shimmering below like an amber circuit board.
items.text_short: night city overlook, amber grid below

items.name: tram-street
items.text: An old tram street of wet cobbles and inset steel rails, catenary wires sketched against the sky, the rails gleaming in twin lines toward a lit junction.
items.text_short: wet tram street, gleaming rails, catenary wires

items.name: airport-perimeter
items.text: An airport perimeter road along the fence line, approach strobes rippling out across the grass while a heavy jet thunders across low overhead.
items.text_short: airport perimeter road, approach strobes, jet overhead

items.name: snow-switchbacks
items.text: Freshly plowed alpine switchbacks between headlight-high snowbanks, sodium lamps steaming in the cold, grit scattered across the packed lane.

items.name: signage-junction
items.text: A five-way junction crowded with stacked lightbox signage and cascading LED boards, every color restated once more in the wet asphalt.
